about_the_game:
FISH WHILE YOUR WORK, WHILE YOU PLAY, WHILE YOUR CREATE...

Strange Shores is a simple fishing game that allows you to catch over 100 fish or mysterious items from your desktop. You can choose to fish alone or charter a trip with friends in online multiplayer.  

Game Features:

  • Resizable window that sits on your desktop  

  • Simple yet engaging fishing mechanics 

  • Over 100 fish or mysterious objects to catch Single-player fishing mode

  • Online multiplayer mode 

  • Unlock new locations as you fish

  • Seasonal updates 

FISH FROM YOUR DESKTOP

With an easily resizable and moveable window that sits in the corner of your screen, you can play Strange Shores no matter what you're doing! And with a passive, yet engaging fishing mechanic, you can keep your attention on your work, creative projects or even other games all whilst fishing.  

FISH WITH FRIENDS ONLINE

Fishing is better with friends. Host an online multiplayer session where you and one other friend can fish side-by-side, send emojis and show your catches. 

CATCH FISH AND MORE

Catch over 100 fish and mysterious objects from lake fish like Perch and Pikes to more left-field objects like a Mini UFO or a Jam Fish. There's a reason this game's called "Strange Shores", you might be surprised what you find...

UNLOCK NEW LOCATIONS

Fish! Fish! Fish! The more fish and strange items you uncover, the more fishing locations you'll unlock. From outer space to the big city, the strange shore of your desktop know no bounds.
